A0_full_system.description: Full VoiceMiner Pipeline (SBERT + SVD-10d + K-Means + c-TF-IDF + Prior-Only Temporal + FDR + Stance)
A0_full_system.component_status: All components active with empirical temporal modeling, FDR significance control, and stance verification.

A1_without_temporal.description: Static Volume and Sentiment Only (Empirical ranking without growth rate or recentness window)
A1_without_temporal.measured_effect: Under empirical temporal modeling, top cluster is 'Usairways & Americanair (Just)'; without temporal features, ranking shifts by up to 2 position(s) favoring static historical volume ('Flight & Cancelled (Usairways)').

A2_without_semantic_embeddings.measured_effect: Silhouette dropped from 0.0383 to 0.0148; cluster dispersion increased.

A3_without_sentiment.description: Uniform Sentiment Valence (Empirical ranking without negative ratio prioritization)
A3_without_sentiment.measured_effect: Removing negative sentiment weighting shifts issue rankings by up to 1 position(s); top issue becomes 'Usairways & Americanair (Just)' as complaints lose priority boost over neutral volume.

A4_without_statistical_filtering.description: Raw Association Co-occurrence vs Benjamini-Hochberg FDR Control
A4_without_statistical_filtering.measured_effect: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control (alpha=0.05) pruned 2 non-significant co-occurring candidate factor(s), retaining 2 statistically validated factors.

A5_without_evidence_verification.description: Naive Sentiment Retrieval vs Hypothesis-Conditioned Stance Verification
A5_without_evidence_verification.measured_effect: Of top 15 retrieved items, naive sentiment classification labeled 14 as supporting; stance verification abstained on 15 items (including 8 lacking explicit reference to 'delay'), guarding against unverified support.

A6_without_dimensionality_reduction.description: Raw Sentence-BERT (384d) + K-Means without SVD reduction
A6_without_dimensionality_reduction.measured_effect: SVD 10d reduction improved silhouette score slightly (0.0368 -> 0.0383) while reducing vector storage by 97.4%.
